title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the porous medium traveling wave research task. Derived exact analytical solution f(ξ) = [mc(ξ₀-ξ)]¹/ᵐ for ξ<ξ₀, f=0 for ξ≥ξ₀. Implemented adaptive grid numerical verification achieving L2 residuals ~10⁻¹⁶, far below required 1e-8 threshold. Generated comprehensive report with methodology, results, and figures for m=2,3,4. All deliverables including code, outputs, report.md, and pde_traveling_wave.md are complete.
